uslaw-usc-t2-s5: Section 5 of Title 2 of the United States Code deals with the naming of men for a poll at large. It sits in Chapter 1, on the polls for Senators and Representatives. Men who stand for Representative to be chosen at large in a state are the subject. Such men are to be named in the same way as men who stand for governor of the state. A bar is set where the laws of the state give a second way.
